## What the judge can and cannot be trusted with

`qwen3.6:35b-a3b` agreed with the v3 human labels on 87% of verdicts (kappa 0.73). `adapts_to_confusion` is below the agreement bar -- read it as a direction. Korean `accurate` verdicts are weaker than English ones. A rise in a rarely-yes property (`concrete_first`, `says_what_it_solves`, `adapts_to_confusion`) needs a blind human check before it is believed.
